title: Counit normalization of the standing affine-line comparison
statement: Fix a finite purity setting P [def-pur-conventions], a scheme Y, and a separated finite-type structure morphism a_Y:Y→Spec(k). Let K be bounded below on the small pro-etale site, with ordinary constructible finite-Tor representative K_e and comparison isomorphism e_K [def-pur-affine-line-purity-comparison]. For the affine-line projection q:A¹_Y→Y, let F_q be its standing compact-support functor, epsilon_q its restricted exceptional counit, and gamma_q the canonical affine-line comparison in standing exceptional coordinates [def-pur-affine-space-comparison]. Let b_q,K be the coefficient tensor-integration evaluation, carried from the chart compactification to the standing one by changeSupport [lem-pur-affine-line-composite-transpose]. Then F_q(gamma_q,K);epsilon_q,K=b_q,K. This is a single-line counit identity; it makes no assertion about the ordered successor, isomorphy or naturality.

proof.text: Expand the specified affine-line comparison as the normalized relative Hom chain of augmentation, with its explicit retained ordinary source witness. Inverting this Hom chain gives augmentation in the chart compactification.

The ordinary right-adjoint uniqueness map defining lineExceptionalIso preserves counits. Transport its left compactification comparison across the site using the same retained line witness; it is changeSupport by the definition of fixedCompactSupportOriginIso. Source equality transport supplies exactly the lineSource coordinates. Therefore inverse-transposing the transported line comparison is standingEvaluation, including empty bases and zero coefficients.

lean.statement:
theorem lineComparison_counit
    (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY] [IsSeparated aY]
    (K : Plus (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) Y)
    (Ke : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) Y)
    (hKe : etaleFiniteTor (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) Y Ke)
    (eK : (comparison (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) Y).obj Ke ≅ K.obj) :
    (AffineLineEvaluation.support P aY (AffineSpace PUnit.{u + 1} Y ↘ Y)).map
        (lineComparison P Y aY K Ke hKe eK) ≫
      AffineLineEvaluation.counit P aY (AffineSpace PUnit.{u + 1} Y ↘ Y) K =
    AffineLineEvaluation.standingEvaluation P Y aY K.obj Ke hKe eK
